candidate.sink_summary: Deletion of user sessions through Django's DeletionMixin which ultimately calls session.delete() on multiple session objects
candidate.guard_summary: LoginRequiredMixin is applied to the view, ensuring that only authenticated users can access this functionality. The get_object method uses get_queryset() to retrieve all user sessions and excludes the current session using exclude(session_key=self.request.session.session_key). This prevents deletion of the active session but does not validate or restrict which other sessions can be deleted.
candidate.risk_pattern: The view allows authenticated users to delete all other active sessions except their own. While there is authentication via LoginRequiredMixin, there are no additional authorization checks or rate limiting to prevent potential abuse such as session flooding or denial of service attacks by deleting many sessions at once.
